objective: Review this code for bugs. Report real defects only, most severe first.

samples.bug: get() never refreshes recency, so the cache evicts the entry that was just read: it behaves as FIFO, not LRU.
A cache hit returns after acquire() without release(): every hit leaks a permit until all renders hang.
charge.js passes cents as `amount`, gateway.js expects major units and multiplies by 100: every customer is charged 100 times the total.
elapsed is in milliseconds but the rate is per second: buckets refill 1000 times too fast and the limiter never limits.
off() with an unregistered listener: indexOf returns -1 and splice(-1, 1) removes the last listener.
Mutable default argument: every Playlist created without tracks shares one list.
The generator is exhausted by the count, so revenue is always 0.
config.timeout is in seconds, setTimeout takes milliseconds: every request is aborted after 30 ms.
DELETE /admin/users/:id has no auth at all and is registered before app.use(requireUser): anyone can delete users.
Check-then-insert without a transaction or lock: concurrent bookings overbook the event.
EMAIL_RE has a nested quantifier: crafted input causes catastrophic backtracking (ReDoS).
sort() compares version strings lexicographically: 1.9.0 is picked over 1.10.0.
